tcgcsv-83903.headline: Up 117% on the year: Blaziken (EX Ruby and Sapphire) 3/109 went from $53.26 on Oct 30, 2025 to $115.47 on Oct 27, and is up 15% over 7 days, up 29% over 30 days and up 53% over 90 days. That is its highest price on file, back to Feb 8, 2024, above the earlier peak of $108.57 on Oct 21. That beats its set over 30 days: up 29% against a +8.2% median for 28 EX Ruby and Sapphire items priced $5.00 or more, and +0.6% for 9937 priced items across the market.
